visualCharacteristics.purpose: Breadcrumb trail of parent pages shown above the article title
visualCharacteristics.layout: single inline row of small text links separated by chevrons, left aligned

contentPattern.structure: one row; one cell per breadcrumb level, each holding a single link (Home, then each parent page in order)

usage: Top of article and quiz pages, before the hero default content.
reuseGuidance: Use for any breadcrumb trail. Add or remove cells to change depth; the block renders nav > ol with CSS chevron separators.
